description: This file defines the GrainTypeResolver class, which associates grain classes with grain types in the Orleans framework. It includes methods for resolving grain types based on class conventions and configured providers.

classes.name: GrainTypeResolver
classes.description: Class responsible for resolving grain types from classes, using providers and conventions.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Returns the grain type for a given class type, using providers or conventions.

methods.name: GetGrainTypeByConvention
methods.description: Generates a grain type based on class name conventions.

methods.name: AddGenericParameters
methods.description: Adds generic parameters to a grain type if the class is a constructed generic type.
